research_question: How well do FNO/DeepONet and baselines learn the parametric conv-diff solution operator, generalise to unseen parameters / inputs / resolutions, and how calibrated is their uncertainty?
hypothesis: H4.1 FNO beats CNN/MLP/DeepONet in-distribution. H4.2 all models degrade out-of-distribution in Pe (200-1000) by > 2x. H4.3 FNO error is approximately resolution-independent; CNN is not. H4.4 the mass-conserving FNO has zero mass error and no worse accuracy. H4.5 ensemble spread under-covers OOD. H4.6 neural correction of a coarse solver beats both the coarse solver and the pure network. H4.7 an FNO initial guess reduces CG iterations.
mathematical_formulation: G: (u0, Pe) -> u(., T=0.5), u_t + u_x = Pe^-1 u_xx periodic; f -> u for -lap u = f
dataset_description: synthetic, generated by the FV solver (dataset card in metrics.json)
limitations: single training seed for point models (ensemble for UQ)
